source: Local Docker PostgreSQL warehouse; read-only independent SQL gold

metrics.definition: Catalog product_events.yaml: events=count all event rows; users=distinct user_id in period; sessions=distinct non-null session_id; viewers=distinct user_id with event_name view; purchases=count rows where event_name purchase or order_purchased; buyers=distinct user_id with those purchase-role events; revenue=sum revenue on purchase-role events.

queries: SELECT source_id, min(currency), count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-12-01' AND '2019-12-31') AS events, count(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-12-01' AND '2019-12-31') AS users, count(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-12-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND session_id IS NOT NULL) AS sessions, count(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-12-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND event_name='view') AS viewers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-12-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND event_name IN ('purchase','order_purchased')) AS purchases, count(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-12-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND event_name IN ('purchase','order_purchased')) AS buyers, sum(revenue) FILTER (WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-12-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND event_name IN ('purchase','order_purchased')) AS revenue_dec, sum(revenue) FILTER (WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-31' AND event_name IN ('purchase','order_purchased')) AS revenue_jan2020 FROM analytics.event_activity WHERE source_id IN ('cosmetics_shop','olist_marketplace') AND ((source_id='cosmetics_shop' AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-12-01' AND '2020-01-31') OR (source_id='olist_marketplace' AND event_date BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-01-31')) GROUP BY source_id ORDER BY source_id

SELECT min(currency), count(*) AS events, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS users, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name IN ('purchase','order_purchased')) AS purchases, count(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_name IN ('purchase','order_purchased')) AS buyers, sum(revenue) FILTER (WHERE event_name IN ('purchase','order_purchased')) AS revenue FROM analytics.event_activity_olist_marketplace WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-01-31'
notes: Olist sessions and viewers are unavailable, not zero. No private credentials included.
